The '''Jedi Embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was located in a section of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] after the Order moved off [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. [[Attros Finn]] was one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stationed there, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] was brought to the embassy when she was afflicted with the [[Dark Plague]].
